training.name: Rhode Island DLT registered apprenticeships and training directory
training.summary: DLT lists technology-related registered occupations, including cybersecurity support, electronics and telecommunications. Apprenticeships combine paid work with instruction, but a registered occupation is not a current opening: ask which sponsors are taking applications. Free or reduced-cost courses have their own eligibility and intake schedules.

training.name: RIC / CCRI / Citizens Information Security Analyst Apprenticeship
training.summary: Announced April 6, 2026, for eligible cybersecurity students transferring from CCRI to RIC. Announced starting wage $28/hour; a one-year program of structured work and classroom instruction. Current intake and open places were not confirmed.
